##### **Job Summary and Qualifications**




##### **This position supports the mission of Swedish Medical Center of optimizing the quality of life of all those served by expanding beyond the traditional focus on medical care to meet the needs of the whole person. The Clinical Coord Case Manager is responsible for delivery of care coordination and delivery of quality patient care with cost effective utilization of resources. This position supports collaboration and communication among the patient/family, physician and the entire health care team regarding the patient’s plan of care and continued needs post\-discharge. The Clinical Coord Case Manager will communicate daily with the discharge planners, social work staff, and UR RN’s to determine the plan of care and communicate this to the physicians. Communication with other members of the interdisciplinary team will be ongoing to determine the post\-acute care needs of the patient. The Clinical Coord Case Manager will be the primary contact for the discharge planners and the social workers to discuss issues that arise with patients, families, and physicians. jobs.title: Behavioral Health Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

  

The Behavioral Health Specialist is responsible for direct patient care, safety, supervision and management of children and adolescents with identified behavioral health needs within diverse environments such as emergency services, medical units, and behavioral health programs. Performs duties under the direction of a licensed professional and implements behavioral treatment plans. Works alongside clinical professionals to provide a safe, supportive, and trauma informed environment.
  

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Provides direct patient care and management of children and adolescents while under the direction of a licensed professional, ensuring a positive, supportive, and structured environment. Intervenes and escalates safety concerns through appropriate channels.
* Maintains therapeutic rapport, unconditional positive regard, and a non\-punitive approach with patients independent of patient behaviors.
* Leads, monitors and collaborates on educational and therapeutic milieu groups for patients per unit expectations.
* Implements individual treatment plans and monitors treatment progress.

**Minimum Qualifications**


* **Degrees**
	+ Bachelor of Science
* **Area of Study**
	+ Psychology, Social Work, Human Services, Biology, or Neuroscience
* **Equivalency**
	+ Four years experience above stated requirements may substitute for bachelor's degree.
* **Licenses \& Certifications**
	+ Basic Life Support
* **Additional Requirements**


	+ License required after hire Must obtain de\-escalation training certification, offered by CHCO, within 90\-days of hire.

**Schedule/Shift**


* 36hrs FT
* Based on dept needs
  

  

**Salary Information**
  

Pay is dependent on applicant's relevant experience.
  

  

Hourly Range: $21\.35 to $32\.03
  

  

**Benefits Information**
  

Here, you matter. As a Children’s Hospital Colorado team member, you will receive a competitive pay and benefits package designed to take care of your needs that includes base pay, incentives, paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance, company provided life and disability insurance, paid parental leave, 403b employer match (retirement savings), a robust wellness program, and access to professional development tools, including an education benefit to help you advance your career.


As part of our Total Rewards package, Children's Colorado offers an annual employee bonus program that rewards eligible team members based on organizational performance. If organizational goals are met for the year, the bonus is paid out the following April.


Children’s Colorado delivers annual base pay increases to eligible team members based on their performance over the previous year.  

  

  

  

**EEO Statement**
  

It is our intention that all qualified applicants be given equal opportunity and that selection decisions be based on job\-related factors. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, or any other status protected by law or regulation. Be aware that none of the questions are intended to imply illegal preferences or discrimination based on non\-job\-related information. The position is expected to stay open until the posted close date. Please submit your application as soon as possible as the posting is subject to close at any time once a sufficient pool of qualified applicants is obtained.
  

  

Colorado Residents: In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age\-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

jobs.title: Remote (LICSW) Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker-West Virginia
jobs.description:
It is Adjuvant's vision to be the nation’s leading oncological behavioral health provider. Our mission is to inspire hope through advancing mental wellness to cancer patients, their families and caregivers. We are looking for empathetic, experienced mental health professionals to come along side us in this endeavor!

 **This is a fully remote position.**


**Pay: $60\-62/hr**

  

Through a respectful, constructive and energetic style, guided by the mission of the clinic, a therapist will seek to facilitate hope and change in the lives of their clients who have been affected by cancer. A therapist is responsible for accepting referrals and maintaining a client load (minimum 18 hours per week).

 **Primary Responsibilities:**


* Counsel clients or patients individually and/or within family sessions, to assist in overcoming dependencies, adjusting to life, or making changes.
* Make internal referrals to IOP if little to no improvement occurs within 8 weeks of OP therapy.
* Guide clients in the development of skills or strategies for dealing with their problems.
* Develop and implement treatment plans based on clinical experience and knowledge, establishing SMART goals with the patient. Treatment plans are to be developed 72 hours after intake and updated / modified every 4 weeks.
* Fill out and maintain client\-related paperwork, including client diagnostic records and progress notes. Progress notes are to be developed 48 hours after every session.
* Prepare and maintain all required treatment records and reports.
* Evaluate clients' physical or mental condition, based on review of client information.
* Collaborate with other staff members to perform clinical assessments or develop treatment plans within 2 days of establishing care with the existing patient.
* Refer patients, clients, or family members to community resources or to specialists as necessary.
* Learn about new developments in counseling by reading professional literature, attending courses and seminars, or establishing and maintaining contact with other social service agencies.

  


**Minimum Qualifications:**


* Masters Degree from an accredited college or university
* Two years of professional level experience in a counselor setting
* Current and active Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker license in West Virginia is required
* Cross‑licensure in Texas is required for this role prior to starting.

  


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* 2\+ years experience in healthcare with oncology
* 1 year experience in Telehealth Settings

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**


Full\-Time, Permanent, Remote, Must reside in the United States

 **About Everyone On**


Everyone On envisions a society where every individual has equal access to technology, expanding their potential and creating a more connected and thriving world. We are a national nonprofit dedicated to creating a world where digital access ignites potential and fosters inclusivity. Since 2012, we've connected 2 million people to reliable high\-speed internet, distributed over 10,000 devices, and trained more than 6,000 participants in digital skills. We design high\-impact, community\-centered programs replicated nationwide through strategic partnerships with government, corporations and nonprofits.


Our holistic approach to digital inclusion focuses on connecting under\-resourced individuals to affordable internet and computers, providing digital skills training to individuals and organizations, and advancing fair and just policies. We partner with community\-based organizations in digitally excluded neighborhoods, primarily serving Black/African American, Latino/x and Tribal communities to equip individuals with the tools to unleash their power, creating a ripple effect of positive change throughout their neighborhoods. Our organizational culture is defined by our five values: adaptability, collaboration, equity, empathy and innovation.

**About the Role**


The Program Coordinator will play a vital role in supporting the day\-to\-day operations and execution of Everyone On’s programs. Reporting directly to the Operations Manager, with a dotted\-line reporting relationship to the Director of Programs, this role drives data\-informed decisions through survey management and reporting, maintains critical digital inclusion resources, manages instructor engagement, and ensures seamless operational support across hardware logistics and administrative workflows.

 **Key Responsibilities**

**Measurement, Evaluation \& Data Management**

* Track and manage the administration of survey instruments across programs
* Analyze incoming program data and generate comprehensive monthly impact reports
* Maintain CRM data integrity to support accurate grant/project tracking and reporting

**National Offer Locator Tool Oversight**

* Oversee the routine upkeep and incident management workflows for the National Offer Locator tool
* Audit and verify source information, partner details, and external links for accuracy
* Pull platform metrics, generate monthly operational reports, and serve as the secondary liaison with contractors to maintain and enhance the National Offer Locator tool

**Instructor Coordination \& Engagement**

* Facilitate quarterly recruitment, interviewing, and onboarding of Digital Skills Instructors (DSIs)
* Provide ongoing support to DSIs by planning, coordinating, and leading periodic curriculum review and professional development sessions
* Manage the monthly DSI "Breaking Bread" meetings by assigning facilitators, crafting agendas, and managing pre\- and post\-meeting communications

**Operations \& Program Administration**

* Serve as the primary liaison between Everyone On and device vendors; identifying, escalating, and resolving recurring vendor issues while ensuring internal staff adheres to established device ordering protocols
* Support the Programs team by managing ordering tools, streamlining fulfillment workflows, and ensuring accurate documentation for partner deliveries of refurbished laptops
* Maintain the inventory system and device order forecast tools
* Maintain the asset management workflow, ensuring quarterly physical inventory audits are completed, and inventory reports are submitted
* Assist the Programs team with administrative tasks, including but not limited to, project reporting, file management, and workflow hand\-offs

### **Technical Support \& Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain cross\-platform workflow automations (primarily using Zapier) to eliminate manual data entry, streamline internal hand\-offs, and improve organizational efficiency.
* Serve as an internal technical resource across teams, troubleshooting data flow issues, advising on AI and software usage, and training staff on basic systems processes and best practices.
* Continuously evaluate current administrative workflows and digital tools, recommending and implementing technical updates to support overall operational scale.

### **Qualifications \& Skills**

* 2–4 years of experience in project coordination, operations, or non\-profit administration
* Proficiency with data workflows \- including capturing information via web forms and surveys, cleansing and manipulating datasets using spreadsheets or light databases, and translating raw data into clear reports, graphs, and stakeholder dashboards
* Proven ability to design, build, and debug cross\-platform workflows using logical branching and low\-code/no\-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make)
* Experience using conversational AI (e.g., Gemini, ChatGPT) for "vibe coding," rapid troubleshooting, and generating custom scripts (such as Google Apps Script) to automate repetitive administrative tasks
* Advanced proficiency with office productivity tools such as Google Workspace and Microsoft Office Suite
* Experience handling vendor relations, supply workflows, and inventory tracking
* Demonstrated ability to lead meetings, facilitate workshops, and manage professional development pipelines
* Exceptional attention to detail, strong time\-management skills, and the ability to manage cross\-functional hand\-offs effectively
* A passion for fostering digital equity, advancing broadband adoption initiatives, and serving low\-income communities of color
* Must be based in the United States and eligible to work remotely

jobs.title: Vendor Risk Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Tailored Brands** is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K\&G Fashion Superstore, which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e\-commerce sites. **About the Job**
We currently have an exciting opportunity for a **Vendor Risk Program Coordinator** to join the Tailored Brands Strategic Sourcing \& Procurement team. The Vendor Risk Program Coordinator supports the day\-to\-day execution of the company’s vendor risk management program, helping ensure third\-party relationships are onboarded, assessed, monitored, and documented in a consistent, timely, and audit\-ready manner. The role partners closely with Procurement, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Finance, Accounts Payable, and business stakeholders to facilitate vendor due diligence, maintain accurate vendor risk records, track remediation activities, and support ongoing program reporting and oversight.
To be successful in this role, you will be highly organized, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment. The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, a foundational understanding of procurement and third\-party risk processes, and the ability to leverage systems, data, and process discipline to enhance vendor oversight and mitigate enterprise risk. **This is a remote, Houston\-based position**. While you will primarily work from home, occasional onsite meetings and team events are required at our Houston corporate office. **What You’ll Do \| Key Accountabilities*** Coordinate vendor onboarding and due diligence activities, including intake review, documentation collection, risk questionnaire routing, stakeholder follow\-up, and completion tracking.
* Maintain accurate vendor records, risk tiers, assessment status, approval evidence, contract documentation, and supporting artifacts in Coupa and related systems.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Procurement, Finance, Accounts Payable, and business owners to coordinate handoffs, clarify responsibilities, resolve process questions, and ensure vendor reviews are completed in accordance with company policies and process requirements.
* Manually transfer supplier and assessment information between internal platforms and related data sources while ensuring accuracy, completeness, quality, and traceability.
* Track open vendor risk findings, exceptions, remediation plans, and follow\-up actions to ensure timely closure and clear accountability.
* Support periodic vendor reviews and ongoing monitoring activities based on vendor criticality, risk profile, spend, data access, and service dependency.
* Prepare vendor risk reporting, dashboards, metrics, and status updates for Procurement leadership, cross\-functional stakeholders, and governance forums.
* Assist with contract and renewal reviews by identifying required risk\-related documentation, approvals, security/privacy inputs, and process gaps.
* Serve as a central point of coordination for vendor risk program questions, process guidance, and vendor communications related to assessments and documentation requests.
* Identify opportunities to improve vendor risk workflows, templates, reporting, and stakeholder experience while supporting consistent adherence to controls.
* Promote ethical practices, compliance with procurement policies, and a strong culture of accountability across the vendor lifecycle.

 **What You’ll Bring \| Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of experience in procurement, vendor management, third\-party risk, information security coordination, compliance, contract administration, or related business operations.
* Foundational understanding of vendor lifecycle management, supplier onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, contract documentation, and ongoing monitoring processes.
* Ability to coordinate cross\-functional work with stakeholders in Procurement, IT, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Finance, Accounts Payable, and business operations.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage intake queues, deadlines, documentation requirements, follow\-ups, and multiple priorities with attention to detail.
* Experience maintaining accurate records in procurement, vendor management, contract lifecycle management, GRC, or third\-party risk platforms; Coupa experience is preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate process requirements into clear guidance for internal stakeholders and vendors.
* Analytical mindset with experience preparing reports, tracking metrics, identifying trends, and escalating risks or process gaps appropriately.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and collaboration tools such as Teams and SharePoint.
* High ethical standards, sound judgment, ownership mindset, and a collaborative, service\-oriented approach.
* Knowledge of information security, privacy, business continuity, resiliency, or regulatory risk concepts is a plus.
* Professional certifications, such as CTPRP, CTPRA, CPSM, CISA, CRISC, or related credentials, are preferred.

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Overview:
**Work Where it Matters**

  

Akima Global Logistics (AGL), an Akima company, is not just another operations contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

  

At AGL, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

 **For our shareholders,** AGL provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

 **For our government customers,** AGL delivers comprehensive supply, transportation, and maintenance services designed to optimize and maintain operations.

 **As an AGL employee,** you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.


Description:

Assesses psychological health using current American Psychological Association Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, develops treatment plans, and modifies plans over time in response to patient progress. Documents assessments and treatments. Consults with health and psychology professionals, helps develop and put treatment plans in place.


Responsibilities:
* Behavioral Health Specialist will serve as a member of the Behavioral Health team in support of the Texas Military Department. Providing service members comprehensive clinical screening, assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, resource referral and connection, crisis intervention, risk/safety assessment, critical incident counseling, behavioral health profile initiation and tracking, behavioral health psychoeducation, SRP/JRSOI support, Command guidance and recommendation.
* The position engages in routine contact with Service Members, their leadership, and treatment providers to ensure all behavioral health needs are met through careful and collaborative assessment.
* Responsible for record\-keeping; expected to maintain detailed records regarding their clients’ treatment plans and progress using a provided electronic health record.
* Completes a thorough intake evaluation of each client’s mental and physical state and their needs upon presenting for treatment. In some cases, the Behavioral Health Specialist may also need to consult with the client’s military leadership during intake and while developing a treatment plan.
* Provide ongoing clinical case management, outreach, and regularly make fitness for duty decisions in consultation with a team of licensed providers.
* Perform in a remote setting with an anticipated 25% travel requirement within the State of Texas.


Qualifications:
* A minimum of a Master’s degree in social work.
* Active Texas LCSW Certification.
* Experience and direct contact with patients.
* Strong working knowledge of human behavioral theory and application of theory to practice.
* Excellent communication skills.
* High level of professionalism.
* Organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Capable of simultaneously working in multiple computer applications (Microsoft Office, TEAMS, electronic health records, and others).
* Ability to work under pressure and in mental health crisis situations.
* Rounded understanding of behavioral health conditions and treatments.
* Ability to pass a pre\-employment background check.
* Ability to receive a favorable TIER\-1 investigation result and obtain/maintain a Common Access Card (CAC).
* U.S. citizen with a valid driver license.
* Experience working with military personnel and/or in a military setting.
* Familiarity with National Guard Bureau behavioral health policy and regulation.
* Independent remote work environment.
* Interdisciplinary experience working with leaders in large organizations.
* Comfort presenting on topics of behavioral and mental health to large groups.
* Knowledge of military and military family life culture.
* Use of evidence\-based screening tools (PHQ\-9, GAD\-7, PCL\-5, CSSRS, DAST\-10, AUDIT\-C).

**Pay \& Benefits:**

* Salary: GS\-12, Step 1 (Austin, TX locality pay rate).

new_jobs.description:
Company Overview:
**Work Where it Matters**

  

Akima Global Logistics (AGL), an Akima company, is not just another operations contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

  

At AGL, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

 **For our shareholders,** AGL provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

 **For our government customers,** AGL delivers comprehensive supply, transportation, and maintenance services designed to optimize and maintain operations.

 **As an AGL employee,** you will be surrounded by a challenging, yet supportive work environment that is committed to innovation and diversity, two of our most important values. You will also have access to our comprehensive benefits and competitive pay in addition to growth opportunities and excellent retirement options.


Description:

Assesses psychological health using current American Psychological Association Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, develops treatment plans, and modifies plans over time in response to patient progress. Documents assessments and treatments. Consults with health and psychology professionals, helps develop and put treatment plans in place.


Responsibilities:
* Behavioral Health Specialist will serve as a member of the Behavioral Health team in support of the Texas Military Department. Providing service members comprehensive clinical screening, assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning, resource referral and connection, crisis intervention, risk/safety assessment, critical incident counseling, behavioral health profile initiation and tracking, behavioral health psychoeducation, SRP/JRSOI support, Command guidance and recommendation.
* The position engages in routine contact with Service Members, their leadership, and treatment providers to ensure all behavioral health needs are met through careful and collaborative assessment.
* Responsible for record\-keeping; expected to maintain detailed records regarding their clients’ treatment plans and progress using a provided electronic health record.
* Completes a thorough intake evaluation of each client’s mental and physical state and their needs upon presenting for treatment. In some cases, the Behavioral Health Specialist may also need to consult with the client’s military leadership during intake and while developing a treatment plan.
* Provide ongoing clinical case management, outreach, and regularly make fitness for duty decisions in consultation with a team of licensed providers.
* Perform in a remote setting with an anticipated 25% travel requirement within the State of Texas.


Qualifications:
* A minimum of a Master’s degree in social work.
* Active Texas LCSW Certification.
* Experience and direct contact with patients.
* Strong working knowledge of human behavioral theory and application of theory to practice.
* Excellent communication skills.
* High level of professionalism.
* Organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Capable of simultaneously working in multiple computer applications (Microsoft Office, TEAMS, electronic health records, and others).
* Ability to work under pressure and in mental health crisis situations.
* Rounded understanding of behavioral health conditions and treatments.
* Ability to pass a pre\-employment background check.
* Ability to receive a favorable TIER\-1 investigation result and obtain/maintain a Common Access Card (CAC).
* U.S. citizen with a valid driver license.
* Experience working with military personnel and/or in a military setting.
* Familiarity with National Guard Bureau behavioral health policy and regulation.
* Independent remote work environment.
* Interdisciplinary experience working with leaders in large organizations.
* Comfort presenting on topics of behavioral and mental health to large groups.
* Knowledge of military and military family life culture.
* Use of evidence\-based screening tools (PHQ\-9, GAD\-7, PCL\-5, CSSRS, DAST\-10, AUDIT\-C).

**Pay \& Benefits:**

* Salary: GS\-12, Step 1 (Austin, TX locality pay rate).
